svg.title: Mechanical keyboard, 75% layout, per-key RGB
svg.desc: A 3D 75% mechanical keyboard with 84 keys and a rotary knob. A rainbow wave of RGB light sweeps across the legends, the plate and the light bar along the front edge, reflected on the desk, while the board types npm run build (done in 1.2s), then git push origin main (main -> origin); every key goes down and lights up the moment its letter appears on the prompt above.
